items.title: UBS Cut Its Applied Materials Target After a Record Quarter. It Still Sees 68% Upside
items.summary: Key TakeawaysUBS cut its Applied Materials target to $640 from $695 the morning after a record quarter, and kept its Buy rating. Analysts have raised their fiscal 2027 estimates since June, so the stock’s 47% drop has come from a lower multiple.

items.title: The Chip Index Has Been Slashed, but These 3 Stocks Have a Path Back

items.title: AMAT Q4 Earnings Beat on Record Semiconductor Systems Sales

items.title: Applied Materials Says Chip Demand Remains “Much Higher Than Supply”
